title: First meeting Charlie Parker: sitting in at Grimes's quartet
summary: Parker asked to sit in during an intermission, played every night for weeks, and the club owner did not mind.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: How did you first meet Parker? Was it after you the Tatum trio broke up?
Oh a long time, yeah, I don't know how long, but anyhow I had my own little
Do you remember where you were playing that night?
It was either the Spotlight or the Downbeat or the Famous Door, which one?
Do you remember the Tondelago club?
Yeah, I played up there, but this wasn't there. Erroll Garner was up there, he started out up there.
How did you first meet Parker? He came in and sat in with your group right?

Well he came in and asked, you know what I mean. I wasn't paying no mind. We were playing.... I believe it was during the intermission. He asked me, is it ok to play. And I say 'yeah, what the hell, yeah, come up and play a couple of tunes.' I never even looked at his horn till he got on the stand and he said it was an alto, which I didn't like altos too much. Most guys play em squeak-- its too high pitched. But man, when he started out to play it was a different thing. He put a different atmosphere all around. We just backed him up, let him play all he wanted, no problem. So he stayed, you know he played. I said 'yeah, go ahead play' Clark Monroe I think
was the owner. He didn't care. Didn't cost him nothin'. So, we played and played the next night and the next night and the next night -- every night I know he was there.
That part I don't know, it was a long time.
Let's see Weeks, weeks, --- I'd say weeks, weeks say go to '39 Let's put it th I really don't know. Let's put it this way -- until he and Dizzy got together, whatever date that was.
